name: Kyteller
source:
Kyteller. Agent of truth. Dedicated to investigate what the secret organizations has been hiding from everyone, controlling their lives. She's wiling to do anything on her hands to go and see further what any other people couldn't.

"There's no need to know the details just to understand them."
